key.name: theme
key.description: system follows the system; hell (light), dunkel-hell (dark with light content) or dunkel (dark) as chosen in the main menu.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window when last run.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window when last run.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when last run.

key.name: mark-seen
key.summary: Mark as read after a delay
key.description: Mark a selected unread message as read after mark-seen-timeout.

key.name: mark-seen-timeout
key.description: Milliseconds until a selected message is marked as read.

key.name: selected-folder
key.description: Account UID and full name of the last selected mail folder as “UID/folder”; empty selects the inbox of the first account.

key.name: conversations
key.description: The message list shows one row per conversation (thread from the folder and Sent) instead of one row per message.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Closing only hides the window; Revolution keeps running and reports new mail until “Quit” is chosen.

key.name: hidden-calendars
key.description: UIDs of the calendars whose events are hidden in the calendar view.
